definitions.explanation: Describes a situation where the timing is bad or one encounters an inconvenient coincidence.
Feeling uncomfortable or embarrassed because of an unfortunate encounter or situation.

examples.japanese: {間|ま}が{悪|わる}いこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}って→降る：00839_furu⟧きた。
examples.english: Unfortunately, it started to rain at the worst time.

examples.japanese: {間|ま}が{悪|わる}く、⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{閉|し}まっていた→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧。
examples.english: As bad luck would have it, the store had already closed.

examples.japanese: {間|ま}が{悪|わる}いとき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}って→鳴る：01143_naru⟧、⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中断|ちゅうだん}→中断：05218_chuudan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The phone rang at the worst possible moment and the meeting was interrupted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪口|わるぐち}→悪口：12672_waruguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}かれて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧{間|ま}が{悪|わる}かった。
examples.english: I felt awkward because the person overheard me talking badly about them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{元|もと}カノ→元カノ：29939_motokano⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧⟦{会|あ}って→会う：00482_au⟧{間|ま}が{悪|わる}かった。
examples.english: I ran into my ex-girlfriend by chance and it was awkward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{嘘|うそ}をついた→嘘をつく：21763_usowotsuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ばれて→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧、⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{間|ま}が{悪|わる}い⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My lie was found out and I felt terribly embarrassed.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 describes bad timing or unfortunate coincidences, often used with こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as {間|ま}が{悪|わる}いこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (as bad luck would have it). Sense 2 describes the feeling of embarrassment when caught in an uncomfortable situation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {間|ま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (good timing; lucky) is the positive counterpart
- ⟦{気|き}まずい→気まずい：06536_kimazui⟧ focuses more on interpersonal awkwardness, while {間|ま}が{悪|わる}い emphasizes the element of bad timing
